## Biography

Cal and John Ermitage go back far enough that their conversations skip the pleasantries and cut straight to old wounds. A technical specialist in a red and black suit with a neatly trimmed chin beard, Cal understands GalCop-era systems well enough to know why modern technology can't replicate them — and well enough to be angry about what was lost. During the DW3 planning, he warned Ermitage about the northern Abyss region, identifying it by its older name: *Umbra Sagittarii*, the Archer's Shadow. His knowledge of the Turner and Halsey family histories, of Hieronymus Halsey's engineering work, and of the Galactic Cooperative's collapse makes him one of the few people alive who can place Ermitage's hidden agenda in its proper historical context.
